conventions.convention: The fixed-boundary space is Hom(c,T_n), with T_0=b and T_{j+1}=T_j⊗a. Internal labels use fixed simple representatives; external simple objects need not be those representatives. Every vertex multiplicity index is retained. At n=0, isomorphic boundaries use a supplied empty-path isomorphism.
Split Hom inner products are linear in the first variable and satisfy g†f=⟨f,g⟩id_c. Orthonormal path bases require unitary category data and orthonormal split vertex bases.

Local split-tree recoupling is postcomposition by a typed associator composite, with target rows and source columns; P_{i,s}=F_i^{-1}Π_sF_i. With adjoint vertex bases, the split recoupling matrix is the entrywise conjugate of the QC inverse-precomposition F matrix.

The normalized self-duality datum is supplied: coev=√d_a v and ev=κ_a√d_a v†, with κ_a=±1 and both snakes required. Its signed loop is δ_a=κ_a d_a; the definition does not assert existence of this datum for every self-dual simple.
Tensor inverses must be actual objects; fusion-ring inverses may have negative simple coefficients; operator inverses concern a specified endomorphism of a specified vector space.

Ising group labels are 0 and η, DD channels are ordered (0,η), and F_D^{DDD} is κ times the normalized Hadamard matrix. R symbols are inverse pullbacks of object braidings. With β²=κ(1+i)/√2, the positive pivotal twist is θ_D=κ/β.

The ell-four root category has negative FS sign and twist s³. Conversion to positive FS changes the odd-triple associator and odd-odd braiding; it is not a vertex gauge. The resulting positive-FS category has twist s^{-1} in the stated inverse-pullback orientation.

Periodic carriers retain both alternating sectors without flux or spin-parity projection. For L=2N, N≥1, each sector has dimension 2^N; odd L gives zero. C shifts bits left, and at N=1 the cyclic bond projector is the identity, without a three-distinct-site cyclic TL assertion.

load_bearing.statement: For κ=±1 and unit-modulus β satisfying β²=κ(1+i)/√2, the displayed complete normal F/R data construct a unitary skeletal spherical ribbon Ising fusion category, with normalized FS sign κ, positive dimension √2, and twist θ_D=κ/β.

Define the local channel projector in the fixed path basis by P_{i,s}:=F_i^{-1}Π_sF_i. This is an idempotent for any fusion category because F_i is invertible. In a unitary fusion category with orthonormal tree bases, F_i is unitary and P_{i,s} is an orthogonal projection.

For n≥1, all admissible paths with every tuple of vertex basis indices give a basis of H_{a,n;b,c}; its dimension is the sum over internal simple representatives of the products of the vertex fusion multiplicities. At n=0 there is one supplied empty-path vector when b≅c and none otherwise.

In a unitary fusion category, with orthonormal split vertex bases and the unitary empty-path isomorphism at n=0, the path composites are an orthonormal basis of H_{a,n;b,c} for the inner product g†f=⟨f,g⟩id_c.
For the supplied normalized self-duality datum, in the multiplicity-free vacuum-normalized gauge, (F^{aaa}_a)_{1,1}=κ_a/d_a and δ_a:=1/((F^{aaa}_a)^{-1})_{1,1}=κ_a d_a.

For the explicit skeletal Fibonacci category and its specified diagonal duals, j_A=id_A is the unique pivotal structure. Both pivotal traces of an endomorphism equal Tr(f_1)+φTr(f_τ), giving positive spherical simple dimensions 1 and φ; the ribbon twist in the supplied pullback-R convention is θ_τ=e^{-4πi/5}.

For either coherent κ Ising category, the full periodic carrier vanishes at odd length and at L=2N has two orthonormal 2^N-dimensional sectors. The specified cyclic F contractions give T=[[0,C],[I,0]], Y_η=diag(Q,Q), and Y_D=κ^N[[0,K†],[K,0]], with Y_D²=I+Y_η and commutation with every represented projector and T; the single-chain map instead satisfies (K/√2)²=(I+Q)C^{-1}/2.

The specified ell-four rank-one tilting negligible quotient is ribbon-equivalent to the normal-data category at κ=-1 and β=-s^{-3}. The stated parity associator and braiding changes, together with flipping the D evaluation, produce the distinct κ=+1, β=s category with twist s^{-1}.
